step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows client application components (EC2 Application Server and Lambda Function) routing database queries through an Amazon Network Load Balancer (NLB) to a cluster of Heimdall Database Proxy instances running on EC2. The Heimdall proxy layer monitors traffic to perform read-write splitting and connection pooling, directing write operations to the Primary RDS database and leveraging ElastiCache's Pub-Sub interface to broadcast cache invalidation messages across all proxy nodes to prevent data drift.

graph.name: Heimdall Data Database Proxy Architecture
graph.notes: Heimdall Data provides a transparent database proxy layer between clients and databases to handle read-write splitting, caching, connection pooling, and lag detection without requiring application code changes.
